translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Yohanes
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I YOHANES

content: Wurungna Alaata'ala men nosida mian
Tumbenapo, koo'po tia dunia nisidakon, Ia men ningaan Wurungna Alaata'ala noko isianmo. Wurung iya'a ruru-ruru' tia Alaata'ala, ka' Wurungmo iya'a uga' a Alaata'ala.
Ia tumbenapo ruru-ruru' tia Alaata'ala.
Wurungmo iya'a a men bo pinsidakon giigii' upa. Giigii' men nosidamo ka' men no'isianmo iya'a, sianta sa'angu'po upa men taasi' i Ia a ninsidakon.
Iamo a pu'una tutuo' men pore, ka' tutuo'-Na iya'a a ruar bona mian.
Ruar iya'a munguruari kapintungan, ka' kapintungan sianta momoko mungurungku'i ruar iya'a.
Isian sa'angu' mian men notaka ia posuu' Alaata'ala. Ngaanna i Yohanes.
Ia notaka mompotuutuu' ruar iya'a, kada' tia tatakana giigii' mian sida parasaya.
Kasee taasi'po i Yohanes a ruar iya'a. Ia tongko' nompopo'inti'ikon ruar iya'a.
Ruar men tuutuu'na, men munguruari giigii' mian, notakamo na tano' balaki'.
Wurung iya'a isianmo na tano' balaki', ka' tano' balaki' iya'a i Ia a ninsidakon, kasee mian na tano' balaki' sianta ninginti'i i Ia.
Ia notaka na lipu'-Na suungna, kasee mian men na lipu'-Na iya'a sian nangalabot i Ia.
Kasee uga' isian mian men daa nangalabot ka' namarasaya i Ia, ka' i raaya'a uga' Ia tarai kuasa kada' sida anakna Alaata'ala.
Raaya'a taasi' anak men ia ngamea'kon mian gause pingkira'na moro'one, kasee nosida anak tia kuasana Alaata'ala.

Wurung men ruru-ruru' tia Alaata'ala iya'a nosidamo mian ka' nodumodongo na ko'onta'. Ka' uga' kita piile'mo a kobalaki'an-Na men ia rookon Alaata'ala na Anak-Na men sa'a-sa'angu'. Kita nimiile' na Anak iya'a biai' a kaporean men kana'.

Yohanes taka mompopo'inti'ikon Wurung iya'a. Ia nengeleelo'kon taena, “Kani'imo i Ia men taengku': Ia bo taka muntuntuni i yaku', ka' i Ia balaki'na tii yaku', gause koo'po tia i yaku' no'isian, Ia noko isianmo.”
Kaporean-Na sian kokabu-kabusanna, ka' Ia sinampang mambarakaati i kita giigii'.
Ukum Torat ia tadulkon i Musa. Kasee kaporean men kana' ia tadulkon i Yesus Kristus.
Sianpo isian mian men nontoo piile' Alaata'ala saliwakon Anak-Na men sa'a-sa'angu' men isian tii Ia. Ia a men nompopo'inti'ikon na ko'onta' Alaata'ala men Tama-Na.
Yohanes Pansarani nuntundunkon wakana
Koi kani'imari a taeni Yohanes tempo isian moomoola'na Yahudi na Yerusalem nomosuu' toro pii imam ka' mian Lewi taka nimikirawari i ia. Taena i raaya'a, “Ime i koo kani'i?”
Ia sian nompopowuni kasee liuliu nonsosoikon taena, “Yaku' taasi' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon.”

Mbaka' taena i raaya'a, “Kalu koiya'a, ime mbali' i koo? Koomo i Elia?” Ia simbati i Yohanes taena, “Taasi'.” Mbaka' ia pikirawarimo i raaya'a soosoodo taena, “Kabai koomo a nabii men peperaion?” Ia simbati i Yohanes taena, “Taasi'.”
Taena i raaya'a, “Kalu koiya'a, ime ansee i koo kani'i? Gause tio bo bantilkononmai na tanaasmai men nomosuu' i kai se' ime i koo men tuutuu'na. Too koi upa a taeem?”
Ia simbati i Yohanes taena, “Yaku'mo a men ia tundun i Nabii Yesaya taena, ‘Isian mian na tano' maleas mengeleelo'kon ka' mambantilkon koi kani'imari: loosikon a salan bona Tumpu.’ ”
Mian men niposuu' iya'a uga' isian mian Farisi.
Taena i raaya'a, “Kalu i koo taasi' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon, taasi' i Elia, ka' uga' taasi' nabii men peperaion, kadai i koo se' mansarani mian?”
Taeni Yohanes, “Yaku' mansarani mian tia weer. Kasee isian sa'angu' mian na ko'omuu men sian kuu inti'i.
Ia taka muntuntuni i yaku', kasee mangalakai lui'na sapato-Napo, yaku' koo'.”
Giigii' iya'a nosida na Betania, na soripi'na Weerkauna Yordan paraas bete'an, na tampat ni Yohanes mansarani mian.
Yohanes Pansarani muntundun i Yesus
Koi liilana i Yohanes nimiile' i Yesus nuntuu'i i ia. Kasi taeni Yohanes, “Piile', ya'amo a Anak Dombana Alaata'ala men mansapui dosana dunia.
Iamo a men taengku' bo taka muntuntuni i yaku'. Kasee i Ia a balaki'na tii yaku', gause koo'po tia i yaku' no'isian i Ia noko isianmo.
Maune' i yaku' taka mansarani mian tia weer kada' samba Israel minginti'i i Ia, kasee tumbena i yaku' sianpo ninginti'i i Ia.”
Ka' i Yohanes uga' nompopo'inti'ikon taena, “Yaku' nimiile' Alus Molinas nalau nda'amari langit koi sapu' marampatii ka' nodumodongo ni Yesus.

Tempo i yaku' sianpo nimiile' Alus Molinas nda'amari langit, yaku' sianpo ninginti'i i Ia. Kasee Alaata'ala men nomosuu' i yaku' mansarani tia weer nambantilkon na ingku' tae-Na, ‘Kalu i koo mimiile' Alus Molinas malau na sa'angu' mian, mbaka' mian men palauionna nono'mo a men bo mansarani tia Alus Molinas.’
Yaku' poko piile'mo suungku, mbali' daa yaku' mompotuutuu' na ko'omuu se' i Iamo a Anakna Alaata'ala.”
Murit ni Yesus men tumbena
Koi liilana i Yohanes no'isianmo soosoodo tia rua' muritna.
Sarataa ia nimiile' i Yesus nolumiu, ia norobumo na muritna taena, “Piile'! Le'emo a Anak Dombana Alaata'ala.”
Rua-rua'na murit ni Yohanes iya'a nomorongor upa men ia ngaan, kasi i raaya'a mae' nongololo' i Yesus.

Yesus ningilinga na komburi'na ka' nimiile' se' i raaya'a nolumolo'mo tii Ia. Mbaka' Ia pikirawarimo taena, “Upa a men sarakonmuu?” Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Rabi, aana dodongoan-Muu?” (Rabi aratina Guru.)
Taeni Yesus, “Mai, lolo' kada' piile'onmuu.” Mbaka' i raaya'a nomae'mo tii Yesus mimiile' dodongoan-Na. Raaya'a notaka toro jaam ampat maamaalom, ka' indo'o tii Yesus pataka malom.
Andreas, utus ni Simon Petrus, tonsoop korua'na mian men nomorongor upa men taeni Yohanes, ka' nongololo' i Yesus.
Ia liuliu nansarak i Simon utusna, ka' nambantilkon taena, “Kai nopootuungmo tii Tomundo' Pansalamatkon!” (Tomundo' Pansalamatkon aratina: Kristus)
Andreas nangatormo i Simon mae' ni Yesus. Yesus nintiokimo i Simon, ka' norobu taena, “Koo Simon, anak ni Yohanes.
Koo bo ngaanon i Kefas.” (Kefas koikoimo i Petrus, aratina: buu'na watu.)
Yesus nengeleelo' i Filipus tii Natanael
Koi liilana i Yesus nuntukokonmo mae' na libutan Galilea. Ia nopootuung tii Filipus, ka' nangange taena, “Mai, lolo' i Yaku'!”
Filipus iya'a samba Betsaida, kota men dodongoan nari Andreas tii Petrus.
Filipus nangarae'i i Natanael ka' nambantilkon taena, “Kai tausimo a mian men ia tundun i Musa na Kitap Torat ka' uga' men ia bantilkon nabii. Iamo i Yesus, samba Nazaret, anak ni Yusuf.”
Ia simbati i Natanael taena, “Minsoop na akal mbali' se' upa men pore bo taka ringkat na kota Nazaret?”

Ia simbati i Filipus taena, “Mai, alaka' piile' suuwung!” Yesus nimiile' se' i Natanael notaka na Ko'ona, mbaka' Ia nuntundunmo i Natanael taena, “Piile', ia men daa tuutuu' ngaanon samba Israel. Ia sianta idekna.”
Kasi i Natanael nimikirawar ni Yesus taena, “Koi upa se' i Kuu ninginti'i i yaku'?” Taeni Yesus, “Koo'po tia i Filipus nangarae'i i koo, Yaku' poko piile'mo i koo na intuna kau ara.”
Taeni Natanael, “Guru, Kuumo a Anakna Alaata'ala! Kuumo a Tomundo'na samba Israel!”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Too i koo noparasaya montookon Yaku' nangaan se' nimiile' i koo na intuna kau ara? Upa-upa men labi tia koiya'a bo piile'oon.”

Kasi taeni Yesus soosoodo, “Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' i kuu bo mimiile' langit kobongkatian ka' mimiile' malaa'ikatna Alaata'ala malau-masawe' mae' na Ingku' Anak Manusia.”

footnotes.text: Yohanes: Yohanes men tama ni Simon, na wurung Ibrani ngaanon: i Yona kabai i Yunus, ka' na wurung Yunani ningaan: i Yohanes.
